synthesis: On the Scout map (a Vue SPA shared by the driver Scout PWA and the admin Bird's Eye Org Map via mapStore.adminMode), the active-kit position layer — the driver's own live 'you are here' dot and, in admin mode, one marker per driver — disappears the instant the date-range pill is switched off 'Today'. Root cause is entirely frontend: DateRangeControl.selectRange() flips mapStore.liveMode=false on any non-Today pill, and liveMode currently gates BOTH the correct historical-vs-live overlay behavior AND the always-current active-kit layer's render + poll. The two backend live-position endpoints (ClarityScoutMapController::kitPosition, ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::driverPositions) take no date-range parameter and always return the latest fix within a fixed ~24h cutoff, so no backend change is needed. The fix is to decouple the active-kit icon layer (marker render + the poll that keeps it fresh) from liveMode/the date filter, while leaving genuinely historical-vs-live overlays (scan-path lines, trail lines, hit heatmap, today-scoped stats/recent-hits) gated as they are.

scope.summary: Frontend-only decoupling of the active-kit icon layer from mapStore.liveMode/the date filter, so icons render and keep polling across all five ranges. Admin (Bird's Eye) sites are settled; whether the driver's own single dot is also in scope is the one open material question (see questions).

proposed_changes.change: Split fetchLive(): always run map.fetchDriverPositions() (+ map.fetchDriverPaths()) every tick/onOnline regardless of map.liveMode; keep dashboard.fetchStats('today') + fetchRecentHits('today') gated on map.liveMode (today-only, intentional per DEV-2179). Preserve the offline/hidden-tab pause for the now-unconditional position fetch.
proposed_changes.reason: ADMIN: even after the render gate is removed, the poll stops refreshing positions off-Today, so markers would freeze/go stale within one ~10s interval — violating AC6 ('always live').

proposed_changes.change: In setLiveMode(false), stop calling clearKitPosition() so the driver's own kitPosition (dot + live trail + localStorage) survives the Today→historical transition; keep activeHeatmaps.delete('hits'). proposed_changes.change: TRAILS (Dalton: persist across all ranges, overlay both): in updateOverlayLayers, drop the `mapStore.liveMode &&` gate from the driver live-trail dot-extension (1354) and PathLayer (1366), and from the admin driver-trails PathLayer (1383, keep `adminMode &&`). In updateTrailArrows (817) and syncTrailArrowVisibility (863), drop the `mapStore.liveMode` gate so the direction arrows ride the now-persistent trail. Leave the scan-paths layer (1322, gated on !liveMode) untouched so it still renders underneath in historical views.

questions.q: Scope: does 'active kit icons' cover ONLY the admin Bird's Eye Org Map markers, or ALSO the driver Scout PWA's own single live dot?
questions.answer: BOTH surfaces — fix the admin per-driver markers AND the driver's own live dot (4 files: ScannerMap.vue, useBirdsEyePolling.js, stores/map.js, MapShell.vue).

questions.q: Should the live TRAIL lines (admin per-driver trail + driver's own live-trail) also persist across all ranges, or stay Today-only?
questions.answer: ALSO persist trails across all ranges, drawn ON TOP of the historical scan-path overlay (overlay both — scan-paths stay, live trail is layered over them in non-Today views). Trail direction arrows ride the trail and persist with it. This expands scope to the trail render gates (ScannerMap.vue:817,863,1354,1366,1383) and the admin fetchDriverPaths poll.

questions.q: Should App.vue's 'My Location'/recenter button and the noKitsReporting empty-state banner (both liveMode-gated) also be decoupled?
questions.answer: No — leave as-is (still liveMode-gated). Not part of 'active kit icons'.

questions.q: Is the disappearance caused by a backend endpoint scoping positions by the date range?
questions.answer: No. ClarityScoutMapController::kitPosition() and ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::driverPositions() take no range/date parameter; both use a fixed ~24h live cutoff. The bug is entirely frontend.

questions.q: Is useKitPositionPolling.js a missed gating site (grep backstop flagged lines 60/102)?
questions.answer: No — false positive. fetchKitPosition()/fetchLivePath() run unconditionally every tick (lines 52-55) and in catchUp (100-101); the liveMode gate at 60/102 only guards the today stats/recent-hits sub-tasks. The driver poll's only effective gate is LiveTracking's mount (MapShell.vue:12), already in the inventory.

grounding.code_flow: DateRangeControl.selectRange(non-today) -> mapStore.setLiveMode(false) [driver: clearKitPosition nulls the dot] + dashboard.setRange (stats/hits only). MapShell's defensive watch also nulls kitPosition and unmounts LiveTracking (stops the driver poll). ScannerMap's kitPosition watch removes the driver's native marker; ScannerMap's liveMode watch calls updateDriverMarkers() which early-returns and wipes all admin markers. useBirdsEyePolling.tick() stops calling fetchDriverPositions while !liveMode. Backend endpoints are called successfully but their range-agnostic results are discarded by these frontend gates.
